name: test_session_invalid_after_logout
description:
After logout, directly navigating to /inventory.html should NOT
        display the inventory page (session must be invalidated).
descriptionHtml:
After logout, directly navigating to /inventory.html should NOT
    display the inventory page (session must be invalidated).

testStage.description:
After logout, directly navigating to /inventory.html should NOT
        display the inventory page (session must be invalidated).

steps.name: Logout, then attempt direct navigation to inventory.html
Assert user is NOT on the inventory page (redirected/blocked)
